title: Circus Site Platform terminology glossary
description: Shared (terminology.json) or project (sites/<site-id>/brand/terminology.json) glossary. Structural validation only; scripts/lib/terminology.mjs performs the full boundary validation, including duplicate keys, conflicting wording, override declarations and the rule that a project may only change the language entries of a shared concept.

concepts.description: Concepts keyed by a stable ID. A project concept with the ID of a shared concept may contain only "languages".

context.description: Where and how the concept applies. Required for a new concept.

sources.description: References supporting the wording. Required for a new concept.

invariant.description: Do-not-translate name used as is in every language.

preferred.description: Approved wording. Not allowed for an invariant concept.

override.description: Required on a project entry that replaces a shared entry for the same concept and language.
